notes.title: Balls!🤬🍆 releasing in Early Access
notes.content:
I have decided to go ahead and release in Early Access already. 🥳🥳
The game still has VERY limited gameplay, and I have also made that clear on the store page.
But for anyone interested its now available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156670/

Since a few people have found their way to this community hub, I am going to post an announcement, and hopefully answer a few questions. 🤓🥳

[list][*]This game is still very early stage, any progress will be announced here,
or on [url=store.steampowered.com/developer/realbutcha]store.steampowered.com/developer/realbutcha[/url] 😴😴

[*]A few people have already been given beta keys, thanks for the help guys. 😍😘🥰

[*]The amount of beta keys that will be given out will be very limited until there is a little more to show. 😫😩

[*]This is just a spare time project for me, so there will be no ETAs or deadlines. I will work on this and push updates when I have time for it. 😎😝

[*]There will most likely [b]NOT[/b] be any public release within the next year. 😢😠😩😭
[b]Thanks[/b] for understanding. ːemofdrː[/list]

The best to all of you out there ːsteamyːːsteamyː
Thanks for reading. 👋👋

If anyone has any further questions about this game, feel free to join the [url=https://s.team/chat/Hi8ZEJxv]Group Chat[/url]. 💬


[i][b]tl;dr[/b] Early stage game in the making, by yours truly.[/i] 🤬🍆
